name: Illegitimate Children
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of illegitimate children, as seen in Deuteronomy 23:2, which restricts a 'bastard' from entering the congregation of the LORD for generations, highlighting the serious social and spiritual consequences of sin. Yet, the Psalms remind us of God's faithful care and provision, even when human relationships fail, assuring that the LORD gathers and sustains His people (Psalms 27:10; 23:1). Children are described as a heritage and reward from the LORD (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing their value despite circumstances of birth. Ultimately, sin separates humanity from God (Isaiah 59:2), but Christ’s teaching warns against hypocrisy that can mask true spiritual condition (Luke 12:1), calling believers to genuine faith and repentance.
